name: 별칭으로 개인정보 열
sql: SELECT x.customer_phone AS p FROM inquiries x LIMIT 5

name: 하위 질의로 개인정보 열
sql: SELECT n FROM (SELECT customer_phone AS n FROM inquiries) LIMIT 5

name: 무거운 교차 결합
sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM c) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c

name: 정상 집계
sql: SELECT intent, COUNT(*) FROM inquiries GROUP BY intent

name: 정상 조인
sql: SELECT p.kind, COUNT(*) FROM inquiries i JOIN products p ON p.model = i.product_model GROUP BY p.kind

name: 문자열 안의 낱말
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE reason = 'DELETE 요청 아님'
